EmailTemplate.name: General Sales Support NPS
EmailTemplate.subject: Request for Feedback on Sales Support Assistance
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi,
We value your feedback and would appreciate your input on how effectively your cases were handled by our General Sales Support Team, both in terms of resolution time and overall satisfaction.
Could you please take a moment to rate your satisfaction regarding the points below, on a scale from 1 to 10, where 1 is completely dissatisfied and 10 is completely satisfied, in relation to the following:
1. The time taken of the resolution of your queries. 2. The overall satisfaction with the resolution provided.
You can complete the survey here < https://qgpeopleexperience.au1.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_39l4J4cByGTDhlA?Q_TS_ID=TS_A46gkotyvQgfyBl&Q_TS_RS=Self&Q_EE_ANON=1&_=1 > .
Should you have any additional comments or suggestions, please feel free to include them in your response.
Thank you for your time and cooperation.
Kind regards
General Sales Support Team
